human_review_checklist.item: No section headings in cover letter
human_review_checklist.note: Cover letter is flowing prose paragraphs, no ## headers

human_review_checklist.item: Cover letter has authentic opening hook
human_review_checklist.note: 'retrieval quality is a trust problem' is a compelling, original insight

human_review_checklist.item: Company name and role appear naturally
human_review_checklist.note: Braintrust appears twice organically, role mentioned at end
Open-source SDK development experience not explicitly shown or acknowledged
Sounds authentic, not generic - specific projects and insights
Email and phone in both resume and cover letter header
Most have numbers but some vague ('Led quality analyses', 'Partnered with design')
Clean formatting throughout, no orphaned headers or broken lists

revision_suggestions: Add a line acknowledging the open-source SDK development aspect - could frame modular component work as 'internal SDK development' or mention any open-source contributions even if small
Strengthen a few resume bullets with more specific metrics where possible (e.g., exact % improvements in retrieval precision)
Consider adding 'open-source' or 'SDK' language somewhere in the cover letter to reinforce fit for this specific role
strengths: Excellent keyword coverage - Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, LangChain, Agents SDK, MCP, vector databases all present
Strong opening hook in cover letter - 'retrieval quality is a trust problem' is memorable and authentic
Good company specificity - demonstrates understanding of Braintrust's focus on evaluation and trust in AI outputs
Clean prose in cover letter with no section headings or markdown artifacts
Concrete technical accomplishments - PDF chunking for biopharma, reranker deployment at scale
Resume uses good formatting with consistent bullet structure
weaknesses: Open-source SDK development experience not explicitly demonstrated - mentions modular components but no open-source contributions
Some resume bullets lack specific metrics - 'Led quality analyses', 'Partnered with design' could be more concrete
Role alignment gap - position specifically asks for 'open-source SDK development' but no direct open-source experience shown
Minor improvement possible: exact dates for tenure (shows Feb 2022 - Jan 2025, should say '3 years' somewhere for clarity)
